text.tspan: The logotype is a custom drawing, not a font setting. It starts from Italiana letterforms and
replaces the terminal z with the swash z of Bodoni Moda Italic. The two are merged and
redrawn so the swash resolves into the baseline.
Never reproduce it by typing “AnaLopez” in Italiana:
the swash would be missing and the fit would be
wrong. Always place the supplied vector.
